title: Forward the paired Undertow root to native VIXEN builds
body: VIXEN CMake now consumes the Undertow-generated text shader interface, but the shared Windows native runner had no Undertow root input. This lane had to translate and forward UNDERTOW_ROOT through native-build.sh and native-build.bat. Add an explicit paired interface-root input to the runner and include it in the build-ready identity so captures cannot reuse a build from another schema tree.

title: Run the no-new-mutex gate in native Windows builds
body: The native Windows configure printed 'no-new-mutex gate skipped: bash/python3 not found', so I had to invoke bash VIXEN/scripts/check-no-new-mutex.sh from WSL through the light queue to get a result (PASS with three existing unclassified rows). Provide a native-compatible gate invocation or run the WSL checker as part of the shared native build setup.

title: Preserve generated recipe output line endings in native VIXEN checkouts
body: The native recipe_simd_check compares exact generated bytes, but Git's text=auto normalized 1,150 CRLF lines in RecipeSimd.g.hpp and 11 in RecipeGlslLiterals.g.h. The first native build therefore failed even though the producer output differed only by those preserved line endings. I had to add path-specific -text attributes and regenerate before the fresh checkout could match the producer. Make generated-output byte preservation or newline normalization part of the declared codegen contract so each output does not need a manual exception.

title: Refresh FrameTargets refs after provider schema changes
body: The native build's frame_targets_schema_check passed after the P784 paired Undertow catalogue was regenerated, then the dependent frame_targets_ref_check failed on stale VIXEN/codegen/generated/gpu/FrameTargets.g.cs. I had to invoke the declared gaia-kind-cs producer and verify its output separately. Keep the FrameTargets JSON and typed-ref projections synchronized as one provider-driven regeneration step so a schema rebase does not reveal dependent stale outputs one check at a time.
